description:
Datacard
	

This is the official VLABench primitive pretraining dataset converted to the
LeRobot format. The dataset contains language-conditioned manipulation
trajectories collected with a Franka Panda robot in VLABench simulation.
This LeRobot version is hosted at:
https://huggingface.co/datasets/VLABench/vlabench_primitive_pretrain_lerobot

Project Page: https://vlabench.github.io/
